{{Top|leg}}
The '''Vallaido Clan''', also known as the '''Vallaido pirate clan''', was a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that operated during the time of [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>

==History==
The flagship of the Vallaido fleet was the ''[[Valla's Glorious Gesture]]''. The Vallaido children began their pirate careers by operating the ''Gesture''{{'s}} [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Siro Simito]] was a member of the clan, but after he realized that he was not suited to the life of a pirate, he left and became a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] racer. At some point afterward, the Vallaido fleet was [[Raid against the Vallaido fleet|devastated]] by the combined forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Seville Family|Seville pirate clan]].<ref name="CRO" />
